summary.result: Our results suggest that policy efforts for reducing commuting time is important for improving commuters well-being.
summary.background: Second, we empirically investigate how increasing commuting time affects happiness using a panel dataset from the 2005~2015 Seoul Survey Data.
summary.method: Particularly, using a car are much more sensitive in terms of their subjective well-being than using public transportation when their commuting time increase.
